notes.title: Update 2.0c
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed random encounters in areas where monsters have already been defeated. Now, on each level, you can encounter different monsters with a power level matching your own. 
[*] Final Boss balance has been adjusted. 
[*] Added a message on the 4th level when transitioning to the final level.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0b
notes.content:
[list]
[*] In this patch, we have fixed the issue with the shield animation automatically not activating after using the block skill by pressing or holding the Block button.
[*] We have also resolved the problem with turrets getting stuck in the lock system after their death.
[*] Furthermore, we have fixed the random monster spawn on the 2nd boss, allowing you to enjoy the game without any unpleasant surprises.
[*] Last but not least, we have addressed the bug that prevented players from seeing the secret animation on level 3 when the inventory was open.
[/list]
[b]Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. We will continue to work on improving the game and enhancing your gameplay experience.
[/b]

notes.title: NEW BIGGEST UPDATE 2.0
notes.content:
Attention, dear players! Have you been eagerly awaiting an update? Well, we have incredible news for you! We are thrilled to announce Version 2.0 - the biggest update to our game yet! It brings a plethora of changes and improvements that will make your adventure even more exciting. So, what can you expect?

[list]
[*] 1.We have completely redesigned the item placements from the beginning of the game to the end to make your adventures even more interesting and engaging.
[*] 2.Do you have a favorite weapon? It has now undergone a full rebalance, allowing you to use it with the greatest efficiency.
[*] 3.The AI for all monsters and bosses has also been reviewed and corrected.
[*] 4.Our combat system is now even more refined. Stamina gain, heavy hits, and combinations have been balanced. Are you ready to fight?
[*] 5.A new window during rolling allows your character to avoid damage (except for Mines), making the game even more dynamic and exciting.
[*] 6.Fighting Mines has become even more interesting! You can now see the visual radius of their damage, allowing you to be more attentive and careful in battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43119633/df20542156e2ecab3290be28615eac93627cac19.gif[/img]
[*] 7.Well, were you waiting for it? Target Lock has been added to our game so you can better control your attacks and weapons.
[*] 8.God Mode is turned off when battling the Final Boss, and the battle has been redesigned to make the game an even greater challenge for you.
[*] 9.Random encounters have been added to places where there are no longer any monsters (random encounters with monsters are disabled in Portals).
[/list]
And much more :)
Monster health display added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43119633/df62b1fae73b0c7ab544fd576cfe526feb1c52c6.gif[/img]
[b]WARNING: IT MAY BE NECESSARY TO START A NEW GAME! BECAUSE THE CHANGES COMPLETELY ALTER THE GAMEPLAY![/b]
Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy this incredible gaming experience with the updated Version 2.0!
